title: Vector Algebra in Maths - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Vector Algebra is a branch of mathematics that deals with vectors, their properties and operations.

  • Vectors are the quantities that have both magnitude and direction, e.g., force, mass, acceleration, etc.
  • Provides rules and operations to manipulate vectors.
  • Crucial in various fields such as physics, engineering, computer science and more.

Why Learn Vector Algebra?

  • Used in GPS, navigation systems and route optimization.
  • Essential for 3D graphics, animation and game development for rendering and object movement.
  • Applied in physics to analyze forces, velocity, acceleration and motion.
  • Widely used in civil engineering, structural analysis and aerospace dynamics.
  • Forms the mathematical foundation of machine learning, computer vision and robotics.

Basics & Core Concepts

These articles build the vocabulary and geometric intuition required for all further study.

  • Vectors in Maths
  • Types of Vectors
  • Properties of Vectors
  • Magnitude of a vector
  • Angle between Two Vectors
  • Orthogonal Vectors
  • Direction Cosines & Direction Ratios
  • Section Formula

Vector Operations

Learn how to manipulate vectors; from basic addition to the scalar triple product.

  • Vector Addition & Subtraction
  • Dot Product
  • Cross Product
  • Triple Product
  • Vector Projection

Note:

  • The dot product (A·B) gives a scalar, useful for finding angles and checking perpendicularity (A·B = 0 ⟹ A ⊥ B).
  • The cross product (A×B) gives a vector perpendicular to both, useful for finding area and checking parallelism (A×B = 0 ⟹ A ∥ B).
